notes.title: Demo out now! View Update [0.65.0]
notes.content:
Play the demo now, download it through our Steam Store Page! 
- This is different from launching the playtest method.

[0.65.0]
Released Practice Solo Mode:
- Play and practice as the Sins against crafty Human AI.

Envy:
Speed decreased by 10%

Greed:
- Additional items will impact less for the speed reduction when attacking.  

Satellite ontop of truck:
- [Interact] to view players on the map.
- Auto activates during 1v1s.

Wrath: 
- Can now pounce when grabbing onto a wall (Hold right click to aim and press space to pounce towards the direction your facing). Pouncing will launch the player much further than a regular wall jump.
- Will automatically attack if you have enough stamina when a player is infront of you during pouncing. 

General:
- Can now set your lobby to Text-Chat only as the host. Text-chat only mode will stop players from talking with their mic, requiring only text chat (Enter key to text chat). This can be toggled host lobby page, or in the options page prior to game starting.
- Players can now mute other players through the Lobby page in the pause menu.
- Can now limit Max Fps.
- Fixed issue of being able to sometimes hear spectators.
- Added more tooltips in options.
- Player's number will show when voting.
- Other minor improvements & bug fixes. 

Practice Solo Mode:
- Can now search for lobbies in the Pause menu during practice mode.
- Auto search for online lobbies option now available in the pause menu.

- All interactables now display a white outline when nearby to indicate to the player they are interactable, i.e., items, cuboards, dead bodies, Elixir, CCTV, etc.

Updated Xray:
- Coloured outline/tint added to Xray.
- Xray now only appears for the Sin player in 1v1 situations (test if OP).
- Xray now stays consistent in 1v1 situations.
- Prides Xray now appears purple.

Pride:
- Updated Prides portal ability, now only having one pair instead of two pairs (makes it simpler for new players to understand, may re-add later the second yellow pair again as a bonus ability after your first few kills).
- The portals continue to spawn using left and right click, but can now again be removed if already spawned in (rather than instantly spawning in a new one and destroying the old).
- Delay between teleporting again reduced from 2 to 0.5.

Wrath: 
- Fixed wrath further to jump higher and work on every space.
- Now releases on damage taken/knockback from weapons or on transform.
- Added temp air control boost & lower gravity after releasing from grabbed wall for 0.5 seconds to aid grabbing onto the next wall.
- Upon pressing space in air as wrath when trying to grab a wall, it will do multiple grab attempts within a short period automatically rather than having to perfectly time the grab.

- Other minor improvements & bug fixes.

- Wrath can now grab onto wall and jump a second time. Will be improve later.
- Major bug fixes.
- Grants 50 'Stealth' score points for dropping dragged enemy player's body into the water.
- Voting a player now also points at them.
- Now drags body backwards instead of forwards.
- Further Increased shovel & bat item spawn rates again - spawn 1 to 2 extra.
- Single Player Still In Development.

- Added in dead body drag feature (right click to drag next to dead body, right click again to release)
- Sloth double-tap space dash attack stamina cost reduced to 30 with higher knockback dealt whilst reducing enemy stamina by 50%. 
- Pride has 20% more air movement control, reduces portal stamina spawn cost from 15 to 10. 
- Increased shovel & bat item spawn rates.
- Test voice focus mode when in first person during voting to hear players louder in focus/centre of your screen.
- Practice mode still in development: should be ready to play test during the next update.
- Wrath climb still in development.
- Stealth features in development for upcoming stealth-based updates.

- Autopsy in development, upon pressing 'E' next to dead body will indicate cause of death
- Crown will now enable short range X-Ray to help aid stealth with the 50% reduced speed when equipped. Completing task (placing crown at the throne room) will permanently give you short-range X-ray.
- Crown item can now be dropped/unequipped when pressing 'R' key with empty hand.
- Crown being equipped will boost other player’s footstep sounds by 3x, helps with stealth to avoid enemies (test)
- Wrath wall climbing features, still in development
- Added show player’s numbers on name tag, set in general settings.
- Press 'N' to mute target player.
- Bug fixes & minor improvements.

- Crown being equipped will slow movement drastically down by 50% when human to encourage stealth & teamwork to complete the task (testing needed)
- Wrath wall climbing in development (should be ready by next playtest session)
- Stealth grab & drag body in development
- Other minor performance  improvements
- Bug fixes

- Sloth does more damage and deals higher knockback when doing AoE (hold left click) attack. Dash attack has higher knockback. Try combining AoE and then dash attack for a more effective/stronger knockback.
- Pride has more air control when moving.
- Added a pink indicator onto the Lust puppets for Sin players to stop confusion.
- New sounds & Music: Chosen Sin/Human sounds added once game starts, kill sounds. Added End of Round Lose music. Updated MainMenu music and End of Round Win music.
- Added 3 second delay to game start (test to see if this delay is better for the games pace or not).
- Other minor changes/bug fixes- Bug fixes: Prison Gates not opening when using pressure plate, not being able to pickup buried keys, as ghost player: voting tags not disapearing, UI fixes etc.
- Other bug fixes.

Lust Character Update: 
- Lust mini minions replaced with AI Human puppets, now able to blend in with Humans and can be both controlled automatically through AI or manually.
- Lusts puppets can be spawned after each kill and take the likeness (name) of the player killed.
- Lust puppet eyes glow pink if around Lust's essence.
- Updated Lusts Journal Pages controls and description.
- Major bug fixes

Temp changes:
- Lust minion explosion temporarily disabled.
- Lust puppets are able to transform into Lust's base form and duplicate.

- Score & Kill count is now awarded for portal kills when teleported player falls into the water or dying by fall damage, it also awards it for kills caused by knockback/launch player (including weapon attacks that apply knockback, sin attacks that apply knockback, sloth throwing player etc.) 
- Lust minion explosion can now damage other sins (except for the lust sin)
- Pride portal can now teleport gluttony and sloth if they’re in human form.
- Increased Gluttony jump stamina cost from 20 to 30
- Texting to all players is now enabled if game over
- Text Chat Improvements 
- Other fixes.

- Added proximity-based text type feature: Press Enter to toggle typing. Proximity range is same as the name tag visibility range (proximity is active only when the typing player is alive and when the game started, except for during voting or for dead/ghost players)
- Lowered wrath flurry attack damage by 20%
- Lowered Envy walk/sprint speed by 10%
- Fixed issue of players not seeing own text chat, can now highlight previous text to copy/paste. Made text feature more performant. Now shows typing indicator under name tag.
- Fixed difficulty syncing issue.
- Fixed first-person players rotation not syncing with other clients/players. 
- Other bug fixes.

- Added a Sin chance feature which lowers the chance of the players who were previously sins. Resets all player’s chance to default every 5 games. For now, chance reduction is set to 20%, e.g. if a player gets chosen, their chance is reduced by 20%, making those other players with a higher chance more favourable for being chosen as a sin. 
-	Fixed: Says 'None' on vote list when your the host when showing for the new player's names only.
- Upon joining, it will first try to check if the session game version is the same as your current game version, will mention if not.
- Other fixes & minor performance improvements.

notes.title: Mini-fix for changing language to Portuguese or Chinese Simplified/Traditional
notes.content: Fixed issue of not being able to change language to Portuguese or Chinese Simplified/Traditional

notes.title: [0.62.7] + 8 New Language Translations
notes.content:
Added Translations:
-	Added Chinese (Simplified)
-	Added Chinese (Traditional)
-	Added Japanese
-	Added Korean
-	Added Russian
-	Added German
-	Added Brazilian Portuguese 
-	Added Tamil

-	Increased Gluttony jump on landed knockback by a quarter and reduced knockback damage by a quarter. 
-	Lust minion passive dmg now counts as kill on leaderboard if the passive dmg kills the player.
-	Fix issue of items spawning inside wall.
-	Spectator’s voice will be muted when joining since players can hear them, when T is pressed, it will say to wait for the next game. Test if this mutes player. 
- Other minor fixes


Note: Changed file executable & folder name within base game folder from MultiplayerTest to Sincognito. It Creates a duplicate folder which the old one can be deleted, doubling game file size from about 350MB to 700MB (preferably just uninstall and reinstall the game). This may require it's launch game desktop shortcut to be replaced as well.

[0.62.5]
- Increased bat knockback amount from 400 to 550 for normal attack, and 700 to 800 for hold left click attack: this includes the up/Z height multiplier (experimental)
- Gluttony now actually deals heavy damage if landing directly on top of someone when transforming mid-air. 
- Reduced gluttony jump stamina cost from 50 to 35: this will allow players to use the jump on landing knockback effect (experimental, might be too OP). 
- Added an option to select the region to show when players find your lobby.  
- Revamped Pride's Mirror Ability
- Fixes teleport point issues, so that it now accomodates for 15 players instead of 12
- Tips popup text not working for translations issue fixed.
- Other fixes & minor changes.

notes.title: Pre-Alpha 0.62.4
notes.content:
- Added languages: Spanish, Turkish & Hindi 
- Gluttony now heals 25 health instead of 10 when eating player
- Fixed lust cannot spawn minion
- Clients can now press fix 2D voice button in sounds options menu to fix the 2D voice issue
- Water death now happens after 5 seconds from game started
- Other fixes
